arxiv-1810-07733.title: Video Object Segmentation using Teacher-Student Adaptation in a Human Robot Interaction (HRI) Setting
arxiv-1810-07733.creator: Mennatullah Siam, Chen Jiang, Steven Lu, Laura Petrich, Mahmoud Gamal, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Martin Jagersand
arxiv-1810-07733.description: Abstract Video object segmentation is an essential task in robot manipulation to facilitate grasping and learning affordances. Incremental learning is important for robotics in unstructured environments. Inspired by the children learning process, human robot interaction (HRI) can be utilized to teach robots about the world guided by humans similar to how children learn from a parent or a teacher.

arxiv-2301-03229.title: On Strong Consistency and Asymptotic Normality of Least Absolute Deviation Estimators for 2-dimensional Sinusoidal Model
arxiv-2301-03229.creator: Saptarshi Roy, Amit Mitra, N K Archak
arxiv-2301-03229.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Saptarshi Roy, Amit Mitra, N K Archak. Estimation of the parameters of a 2-dimensional sinusoidal model is a fundamental problem in digital signal processing and time series analysis. In this paper, we propose a robust least absolute deviation (LAD) estimators for parameter estimation. The proposed methodology provides a robust alternative to non-robust estimation techniques like the least squares estimators, in situations where outliers are present in the data or in the presence of heavy tailed noise.

arxiv-2306-15885.title: Investigating properties of heavy and superheavy atomic systems with p 3 p^{3} configurations
arxiv-2306-15885.creator: H. X. Liu 1,2, Y. M. Yu 2,4, B. B. Suo 3, Y. Liu 1, B. K. Sahoo 5
arxiv-2306-15885.description: Abstract We have investigated energies and spectroscopic properties such as lifetimes, g J g_{J} factors, and hyperfine structure constants of the neutral atoms P through Mc belonging to Group-15, singly ionized atoms S + through Lv + of Group-16 and doubly ionized atoms Cl 2+ through Ts 2+ of Group-17 of the periodic table.

arxiv-2402-00941.title: Detecting Boosted Dark Photons with Gaseous Detectors
arxiv-2402-00941.creator: Michael L. Graesser, R. Andrew Gustafson, Kate Hildebrandt, Varun Mathur, Ian M. Shoemaker
arxiv-2402-00941.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Michael L. Graesser, R. Andrew Gustafson, Kate Hildebrandt, Varun Mathur, Ian M. Shoemaker. We search for indirect signals of 𝒪 \mathscr{O} (keV) dark matter annihilating or decaying into 𝒪 \mathscr{O} (eV) dark photons. These dark photons will be highly boosted, predominantly transversely polarized, have decay lengths larger than the Milky Way, and can be absorbed by neutrino or dark matter experiments at a rate dependent on the photon-dark photon kinetic mixing parameter and the optical properties of the experiment.

arxiv-2505-13420.title: Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves in Palatini 𝒇 ⁡ ( 𝑹 ) f(R) Gravity
arxiv-2505-13420.creator: Samuel Sánchez López, and José Jaime Terente Díaz
arxiv-2505-13420.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Samuel Sánchez López, and José Jaime Terente Díaz. Primordial scalar perturbations that reenter the horizon after inflation may induce a second-order Gravitational Wave spectrum with information about the primordial Universe on scales inaccessible to Cosmic Microwave Background experiments. In this work, we develop a general framework for the study of Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves in Palatini f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity, a theory that was proven to successfully realise inflation and quintessence, and consider the case of the Starobinsky-like model as an example.

arxiv-2512-17657.title: Peeking Into The Future For Contextual Biasing
arxiv-2512-17657.creator: Ramaneswaran Selvakumar \sthanks Work done during internship at Samsung Research America, Cindy Tseng, Eesung Kim, Vijendra Raj Apsingekar, Yun Tang
arxiv-2512-17657.description: Abstract While end-to-end (E2E) automatic speech recognition (ASR) models excel at general transcription, they struggle to recognize rare or unseen named entities (e.g., contact names, locations), which are critical for downstream applications like virtual assistants. In this paper, we propose a contextual biasing method for attention based encoder decoder (AED) models using a list of candidate named entities.

pmc-11356654.title: Multifunctional Design of Catalysts for Seawater Electrolysis for Hydrogen Production
pmc-11356654.creator: Chenmeng Cui, Haonan Zhang, Dan Wang, Jihuan Song, Ying Yang
pmc-11356654.description: Direct seawater electrolysis is a promising technology within the carbon-neutral energy framework, leveraging renewable resources such as solar, tidal, and wind energy to generate hydrogen and oxygen without competing with the demand for pure water. High-selectivity, high-efficiency, and corrosion-resistant multifunctional electrocatalysts are essential for practical applications, yet producing stable and efficient catalysts under harsh conditions remains a significant challenge.

pmc-11476068.title: Mapping the cell therapy landscape: insights into clinical trials and regulatory advances in China
pmc-11476068.creator: Xin Du, Xingxian Luo, Lanqiu Liu, Yanlin Cao, Yajuan Zhang, Yi Zhang
pmc-11476068.description: In recent years, cell therapy research and commercialization have significantly accelerated, especially after the US FDA approved CAR-T therapy. While cell therapy now leads immuno-oncology in clinical trials, challenges such as redundant R&D, target clustering, and unmet clinical need remain.

pmc-11538645.title: Assessing the effectiveness of Renzhu Jianwei Granula in managing precancerous lesions of gastric cancer: A meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials
pmc-11538645.creator: Tu Chen, Lingling Zhou, Zixuan Wang, Tianhao Wu, Guiling Wang, Heng Zhang
pmc-11538645.description: BackgroundRenzhu Jianwei Granula (RJG) is a traditional Chinese medicine compound initially formulated to address precancerous lesions for gastric cancer. The aim of this study was to assess RJG's efficacy in treating precancerous lesions of gastric cancer through a comprehensive meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.

Soybean production in the southern region accounted for 15.

pmc-12445829.title: Emerging trend of increasing spring frost damage for beech at higher elevations in the Jura Mountains: evidence from tree‐ring data
pmc-12445829.creator: Yann Vitasse, Lynsay Spafford, Joanna Reim, Frederik Baumgarten, Elisabet Martínez‐Sancho
pmc-12445829.description: Summary Late spring frost (LSF) severely impacts tree growth and forest productivity, with global warming potentially altering LSF risk due to asymmetric changes in vegetation onset and frost timing. However, reconstructing past frost regimes with climatic and phenological data remains challenging.

pmc-12616953.title: Two novel red-FRET ERK Biosensors in the 670-720 nm range
pmc-12616953.creator: Nicholaus L DeCuzzi, Jason Y Hu, Florene Xu, Brayant Rodriguez, Michael Pargett, John G Albeck
pmc-12616953.description: Cell fate decisions are regulated by intricate signaling networks, with Extracellular signal-Regulated Kinase (ERK) being a central node in the control of cell proliferation and differentiation. ERK typically cooperates with a network of other regulators, making it necessary to study multiple signaling pathways simultaneously at the single-cell level.

pmc-13083615.title: Baseline positional asymmetry and its association with planned tooth movements in clear aligner therapy
pmc-13083615.creator: Tugba Haliloglu Ozkan, Elif Nadide Akay Polat
pmc-13083615.description: BackgroundDigital treatment planning software in clear aligner (CA) therapy incorporates virtual simulations to generate planned tooth movements. While baseline tooth positions constitute one of the geometric inputs to digital setups, limited information is available regarding the association between pre-treatment positional asymmetry and the magnitude of planned movements, and how these associations vary by tooth and movement type.

pmc-13419850.title: Intrusive Mental Images Resembling Psychosis in a Patient With Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
pmc-13419850.creator: Shaurya P Kushwaha, Maghav Sharma, Shradha Puri
pmc-13419850.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) may be present with distressing intrusive thoughts, urges, or images. When the content is violent, sexual, religious, or linked to magical thinking, severe OCD can be mistaken for psychosis. We present a 19-year-old man with a six-year history of ego-dystonic intrusive harm-related thoughts and images focused on family members, along with checking, touching, counting, reassurance seeking, religious mental rituals, and sexual obsessions.

pmc-13486106.title: Cardiac sympathetic nerve activity following mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair verified by 123I-metaiodobezylguanidine (MIBG) scintigraphy among disproportionate secondary mitral regurgitation
pmc-13486106.creator: Takahide Arai, Yodo Gatate, Keisuke Matsuo, Mitsunobu Nagai, Hiroki Hoya, Yohji Matsusaka, Yoshie Nakajima, Shiro Iwanaga, Ichiei Kuji, Shintaro Nakano
pmc-13486106.description: This study evaluated the cardiac sympathetic nerve (CSN) activity following mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (M-TEER) using 123I-metaiodobenzylguanidine (MIBG) scintigraphy among disproportionate secondary mitral regurgitation (SMR). Among the 31 patients who underwent M-TEER between November 2018 and December 2020, 20 patients who underwent pre-procedural and 1-year post-procedural MIBG scintigraphy were included.

uslaw-usc-t3-s109.title: 3 U.S.C. § 109 — Public property in and belonging to the Executive Residence at the White House
uslaw-usc-t3-s109.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t3-s109.description: United States Code, Title 3 (The President); Chapter 2 (Office And Compensation Of President). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The steward, housekeeper, or such other employee of the Executive Residence at the White House as the President may designate, shall under the direction of the President, have the charge and custody of and be responsible for the plate, furniture, and public property.
